integrity_correction.removed_address: Put your home in expert hands
integrity_correction.reason: Generic Savills corporate/home page was not a lot-specific auction evidence URL and could not legitimately carry the inherited 24-Apr-2014 auction date.

exact_failed_route.blocker: Free exact-date result/catalogue document discovery did not surface a usable Savills result document or a lot-specific surviving Savills page carrying the 24-Apr-2014 date. Search results were generic Savills pages or irrelevant matches, so none were accepted as auction evidence.

next_safe_repair_implemented_same_run.method: Search exact-date public auction-result pages for property/postcode/lot clues; public pages are discovery-only. A row can persist only if the clue resolves to a lot-specific auctions.savills.co.uk URL and that Savills lot page itself carries the same frontier auction date and passes commercial/mixed-use classification. Generic Savills pages are categorically rejected.
next_safe_repair_implemented_same_run.following_route_if_empty: Use any exact-date public address/lot clues as literal keys in Common Crawl WARC indexes for legacy Savills LotDetails/LotList captures, requiring the archived Savills capture itself to bind the clue to 24-Apr-2014 before persistence.
